versions.changelog:
Initial release – publish AI Agent–generated digital assets to a public marketplace similar to Etsy.

- Upload and share digital assets (images, 3D models, audio, video) with live, shareable URLs.
- Supports digital downloads, preview/gallery views, and manufacturing-on-demand for physical products.
- Set prices for downloads and monetize your creations.
- Integration with Craftsman Agent’s Gallery, Workspace, Marketplace, and Store for full asset lifecycle management.
- CLI instructions provided for quick setup and publishing.
